name: devicekit-explorer
description: A dashboard file manager for your devices: browse, upload, download, preview, rename, mkdir, and delete files over the agent's file API. The first builtin extension to ship a real frontend page and a NodeDetail tab — not just a settings panel.
author: Juan Denis
